commands: set -u; echo '=== USBMODEM NODES ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usbmodem* /dev/tty.usbmodem* 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== USBSERIAL NODES (names only) ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usbserial* /dev/tty.usbserial* 2>/dev/null || true; count=0; for p in /dev/cu.usbmodem*; do [ -e "$p" ] || continue; count=$((count+1)); echo CANDIDATE=$p; done; echo USBMODEM_COUNT=$count
